pairs.note: Answer states the same hurdle values as the key: 1.25% per quarter (5.0% annualized) on the income incentive fee and no hurdle on the capital gains incentive fee. The key's added detail (100% catch-up between 1.25% and 1.4286% per quarter, prior quarter-end NAV basis, non-cumulative/non-compounding with no shortfall carryforward) elaborates the same hurdle structure; the answer contradicts none of it and captures the governing rate and its application to both fee components.

Key affirms a loss carryforward exists on the capital gains incentive fee: computed cumulatively from inception so realized losses and unrealized depreciation carry forward perpetually and must be recovered before further capital gains fees. Answering NOT_APPLICABLE denies any such provision, reversing the key's meaning; capturing only the 'no high-water mark on the income fee' half omits the required capital gains loss-carryforward element.
